audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0 and 6 disagree with the packet on both layers. Chart reads [Tahm Kench, Skill, Mordekaiser x5]; packet levelChart is [Skill, Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Skill]. The page's own prose already matches the packet: whys[0] 'just farm and deny', whys[6] 'He never out-duels you, but his R roam and unkillable max-HP frontline make him a map threat'.
audit.why: Neither champion has a level-1 all-in — Thick Skin refunds Mordekaiser's chip and Mordekaiser has one ability. Late, Tahm Kench does not beat Mordekaiser 1v1; he stops being a lane problem and becomes a map and durability problem, which is 'even', not a loss.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, 2+ items Skill; rows 1-5 unchanged. Matched pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abyssal Dive is called 'His escape + shield' in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t. It is not a shield — Riot's text is 'Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area' (1000-1200 range, 21-17s). The shield is Thick Skin (E, 3s), which converts stored damage. Tongue Lash's stun condition is also stated only in passing: it stuns only when the target already has 3 An Acquired Taste stacks, and Devour requires those same 3 stacks on an enemy — so three stacks buys the stun or the eat, not both. Restating the mirror: Devour needs no stacks on an ALLY, so the peel is always available even when the eat is not.
audit.why: A player tracking 'his shield' will hold the all-in for the wrong cooldown, and a player who does not know the stacks are shared between stun and Devour will misjudge which one is coming.
audit.corrected: Abyssal Dive: 1000-1200 range reposition with a knockup, 21/20/19/18/17s — no shield attached. Thick Skin: 3s, converts stored damage into a shield and heals out of combat. Tongue Lash: 900 range, 7-5s, heals him on champion hit, stuns only at 3 stacks. Devour: needs 3 stacks on an enemy, none on an ally.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page ties Grievous Wounds to this matchup, despite Tongue Lash healing him on every champion hit and Thick Skin healing back stored damage out of combat.
audit.why: It is the _missing entry for this matchup and it decides every extended trade — the sustain, not the shield, is what refunds your chip.
audit.corrected: Hold Grievous Wounds for the extended trade: Thick Skin banks what you deal into grey health and heals it back out of combat.

notes: Main correction: three fields called Abyssal Dive a shield. It is a reposition with a knockup; the shield is Thick Skin. That mattered because the whole page tells the reader to commit on 'his escape + shield' cooldown, which conflates a 21-17s ability with a 3s one. Also restated from the already-audited mirror: three An Acquired Taste stacks buy the Tongue Lash stun OR Devour, not both. The packet's suspectName here ('Darkness Rise's') is a false positive from the possessive and should not be touched. The mirror's own open question — whether Abyssal Dive's cooldown resets inside Realm of Death — does not appear on this side's page, so nothing to remove here; it still needs a human ruling on the Tahm Kench page. Recurring kit bug unchanged: Obliterate's grounding flag is unsupported by Riot's description and I asserted nothing from it.
